name: Dual Littlestone Dimension of Full Cube
proof: The n coordinate functions in the dual class realize every binary pattern on a selected collection of d concepts provided $2^d\le n$, so dual VC dimension gives $\mathrm L^*\ge\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$. Conversely a depth-d shattered tree needs $2^d$ distinct coordinate functions, and there are only n. Hence equality holds.
references: Direct calculation from the full-cube definition and the Littlestone tree definition.
